title: Drunk Teen Realizes He Killed a Girl
description:
Bodycam footage captures the aftermath of a deadly crash in Waukesha County, Wisconsin, where police say 19-year-old Jason Zehe drove drunk through a stop sign and slammed into multiple vehicles, killing 17-year-old Megan Voss and fatally injuring her dog. At the hospital, Zehe denies drinking, until investigators inform him the teen didn’t survive. Watch the full incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
